name: This Game Is Not A Dating Sim
source:
A melon in a city of food dates a famous grapefruit actress, and has to survive a day without being bothered by paparazzi while they go on their first date.

[From [url=http://insanityjam.com/2/viewtopic.php?id=52]Insanity Jam[/url]]

Created for Insanity Jam 2.
translation:
美食之城的甜瓜与著名的柚子女演员约会，在第一次约会时，他必须在不被狗仔队打扰的情况下度过一天。

[来自[url=http://insanityjam.com/2/viewtopic.php?id=52]Insanity Jam[/url]]

为Insanity Jam 2创建。
